summary: Iteration 25 - POS Rewrite, RFID Access Control, and Corporate Colors Testing Complete. All 15 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend UI verified: POS page with tabs (TPV, Productos, Ventas, Estadisticas), category filters, cart, product grid, product creation dialog with category field. AdminSettings page shows corporate color pickers section (bg_color, menu_color, text_color, secondary_color).

issues: Console warning: Missing `Description` or `aria-describedby={undefined}` for {DialogContent} - accessibility improvement recommended

seed_data_creation: Test products created and cleaned up during testing (TEST_Product_*, TEST_Sale_Product_*, TEST_Updated_Product). Test RFID member created if needed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 tested all three new features: 1) POS Rewrite - POST/GET/PUT/DELETE /api/pos/products with category field, GET /api/pos/categories returns distinct categories, POST /api/pos/sales processes sales with items array, GET /api/pos/sales returns sales history, GET /api/pos/stats returns today_total, month_total, total_products, low_stock_products. 2) RFID Access Control - PUT /api/members/{id}/rfid assigns/removes RFID UID, POST /api/access/validate detects RFID vs QR based on input format (short hex string <=20 chars = RFID), duplicate RFID assignment rejected with 400. 3) Corporate Colors - PUT /api/gyms/{id} accepts primary_color, bg_color, menu_color, text_color, secondary_color. AdminLayout.js injects CSS variables from gym data. AdminSettings.js has color pickers section at lines 682-728.

pos_product_crud.details: Products have category, cost_price, sale_price, stock, barcode fields. Soft delete sets active=false.

pos_categories.details: Returns distinct categories from products. Defaults to ['general'] if no categories.

pos_sales.details: Sales include items array with product_id, quantity, unit_price. Decreases stock on sale.

pos_stats.details: Returns today_total, month_total, today_revenue, month_revenue, total_products, low_stock_products (stock <= 5).

rfid_assign.details: Assigns RFID UID to member. Normalizes to uppercase, removes colons. Empty string removes RFID.

rfid_duplicate_rejected.details: Returns 400 if RFID already assigned to another member.

rfid_access_validation.details: Detects RFID vs QR based on input format. RFID: short hex string (<=20 chars, hex chars only, no pipe). Returns access_type='rfid' for RFID access.

corporate_colors_api.details: Accepts primary_color, bg_color, menu_color, text_color, secondary_color. Returns updated gym data.

corporate_colors_ui.details: Color pickers section at lines 682-728. Inputs have data-testid: bg-color-input, menu-color-input, text-color-input, secondary-color-input.

pos_frontend_tabs.details: 4 tabs: TPV, Productos, Ventas, Estadisticas. data-testid: pos-tab-pos, pos-tab-products, pos-tab-sales, pos-tab-stats.

pos_frontend_categories.details: Category filter tabs with 'Todos' and dynamic categories from products. data-testid: category-tabs.

pos_frontend_cart.details: Cart section with items, quantity controls, payment method selection, checkout button. data-testid: pos-cart.

pos_frontend_product_form.details: Product creation dialog with name, description, category (select + add new), cost_price, sale_price, stock, barcode fields.
